Title Card.pickWhen: Opening the video or a new section; narration introduces a named topic.

kicker.description: Small accent-coloured label above the title — Label above the title, e.g. "Chapter 2". — 1-3 words, max 1 line(s)

title.description: The title — The main title. — 1-8 words, max 2 line(s)

subtitle.description: Supporting line under the title — One supporting line. — 2-10 words, max 2 line(s)
examples: The story of India's digital payment boom

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

example_props.title: How UPI changed India
example_props.subtitle: The story of India's digital payment boom

Title + Metadata.pickWhen: Introducing an event, place, person or organisation together with 2–4 key facts (date, place, category, source).

title.description: The title — The main title. — 1-8 words, max 2 line(s)

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

label.description: Chip text — A fact: date, place, category, source. — 1-4 words, max 1 line(s)

icon.description: Lucide icon name for this item (fallback: circle)

meta.description: Row of fact chips under the title
meta.title: Chip

layout.description: Chips side by side or one per line

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

Big Number.pickWhen: Narration states one striking figure: "₹4,200 crore", "73% of Indians", "3 million users".

prefix.description: Symbol before the number — Currency or symbol before the number: ₹, $, ~. — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

unit.description: Unit after the number — After the number: %, km, users, per day. — 1-2 words, max 1 line(s)

label.description: Label under the number — What the number is: "spent on ads in 2025". — 1-8 words, max 2 line(s)

context.description: Supporting line under the label — One line that makes the number meaningful. — 2-16 words, max 2 line(s)
examples: More than TV and print combined for the first time

change_label.description: Text after the change value — What the change is measured against: "vs 2024". — 1-4 words, max 1 line(s)

value.description: The big number (formatted by the template) — Raw value, e.g. 42000000000 for ₹4,200 crore, 73 for 73%.

change.description: Change indicator under the label (arrow + value) — Percent points when change_type = percent (12.4 = +12.4%), otherwise same unit as value. Negative = down.

icon.description: Icon above the number (fallback: none (no icon shown))

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

format.description: How numbers are displayed: plain = raw digits, indian_compact = ₹1.2 Cr / 45 L style grouping, international_compact = 1.2M / 45K style grouping.

change_type.description: How change is shown: +12.4% or +₹1.2 Cr

direction.description: Arrow direction (auto = from the sign of change)

good_direction.description: Which direction is shown green (e.g. down for prices or deaths)

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

example_props.label: spent on digital ads in 2025
example_props.context: More than TV and print combined for the first time

Number Comparison.pickWhen: Two figures are compared, or the same metric before and after: "from ₹12 lakh to ₹45 lakh", "India 7% vs China 5%".

title.description: Heading above the comparison — What is being compared: "Average salary, 2015 vs 2025". — 1-8 words, max 1 line(s)

label_a.description: Label under value A — What value A is: "2015", "India", "Before". — 1-4 words, max 2 line(s)

label_b.description: Label under value B — What value B is. — 1-4 words, max 2 line(s)

prefix.description: Symbol before both numbers — Currency or symbol for both values: ₹, $. — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

unit.description: Unit after both numbers — Unit for both values: %, km, per year. — 1-2 words, max 1 line(s)

change_label.description: Text after the difference — Words after the difference: "in ten years", "higher". — 1-4 words, max 1 line(s)

context.description: Supporting line at the bottom — One line explaining why the difference matters. — 2-16 words, max 2 line(s)
examples: Salaries grew almost four times faster than rent

value_a.description: First (left / before) number — Raw value, e.g. 1200000.

value_b.description: Second (right / after) number — Raw value, same unit as value A.

icon_a.description: Icon above value A (fallback: none (no icon))

icon_b.description: Icon above value B (fallback: none (no icon))

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

layout.description: side_by_side: two cards with VS · before_after: A → B with an arrow · bars: two bars sized by value (positive values only)

format.description: How numbers are displayed: plain = raw digits, indian_compact = ₹1.2 Cr / 45 L style grouping, international_compact = 1.2M / 45K style grouping.

show_change.description: How B differs from A: +275% · 3.8× · +₹33 L · hidden (auto picks percent, or multiple for big jumps)

good_direction.description: Which direction is shown green (down for prices, deaths, pollution)

highlight.description: Which value is drawn in the accent colour

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

example_props.title: Average IT salary
example_props.context: Salaries grew almost four times faster than rent

Quote Card.pickWhen: Narration quotes a real person, speech, document or report word for word.

quote.description: The quotation — Verbatim words only, no quotation marks (the template adds them). Trim with "…" if needed. — 3-30 words, max 4 line(s)
examples: At the stroke of the midnight hour, when the world sleeps, India will awake to life and freedom.

speaker.description: Speaker name — Full name of the person quoted. — 1-5 words, max 1 line(s)

role.description: Line under the speaker name — Who they are, at the time of the quote. — 1-7 words, max 1 line(s)

source.description: Small source line — Where and when it was said: speech, interview, book, date. — 1-7 words, max 1 line(s)

highlight.description: Words of the quote drawn in the accent colour — Exact words from the quote to draw in the accent colour. — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)
examples: India will awake to life and freedom

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

portrait_url.description: Photo of the speaker (portrait_left / portrait_right layouts)

layout.description: Quote alone, or beside a portrait (portrait layouts need portrait_url; without it the card is centred)

align.description: Text alignment in the centred layout (portrait layouts are left-aligned)

quote_mark.description: Large accent quote mark above the quote

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

example_props.quote: At the stroke of the midnight hour, when the world sleeps, India will awake to life and freedom.
example_props.speaker: Jawaharlal Nehru
example_props.highlight: India will awake to life and freedom

validation_notes.message: Highlight phrase is not in the quote — nothing is highlighted
validation_notes.rule: Fails when `highlight` is set but its words don't appear in `quote`.

validation_notes.message: Leave out quotation marks — the template adds its own
validation_notes.rule: Fails when `quote` (trimmed) starts or ends with a quotation-mark character.

Key Statement.pickWhen: A thesis, warning, takeaway or "here's the thing" moment the viewer must remember.

statement.description: The big statement — One clear sentence, no more than 14 words. — 2-14 words, max 3 line(s)
examples: Your salary is not your wealth.

highlight.description: Words of the statement that get the emphasis — Exact words from the statement to emphasise. — 1-6 words, max 1 line(s)

explanation.description: Supporting line under the statement — One or two short sentences that explain the statement. — 3-24 words, max 3 line(s)
examples: What you keep and invest decides how rich you become.

label.description: Pill above the statement — Small tag above: "Key takeaway", "Warning", "Remember". — 1-3 words, max 1 line(s)

icon.description: Icon inside the label pill (fallback: none (text only))

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

emphasis.description: How the highlight is drawn: marker sweep behind the words · underline sweep · accent-coloured words

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

example_props.label: Key takeaway
example_props.statement: Your salary is not your wealth.
example_props.explanation: What you keep and invest decides how rich you become.

validation_notes.message: Highlight phrase is not in the statement — nothing is emphasised
validation_notes.rule: Fails when `highlight` is set but its words don't appear in `statement`.

Structured List.pickWhen: "3 reasons why", "the causes are", features, examples, steps without order, or a recap of key points.

title.description: Heading above the list — What the list is: "3 reasons UPI won". — 1-8 words, max 1 line(s)

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

text.description: Item text — One point per item, parallel wording across items. — 1-9 words, max 2 line(s)

sub.description: Smaller line under the item text — Optional detail under the item. — 1-10 words, max 2 line(s)

icon.description: Lucide icon name for this item (fallback: number)

image_url.description: Item picture (thumbnail in list layout, card top in cards layout)

layout.description: Rows with a marker on the left, or a grid of cards

marker.description: What marks each item (auto = image if every item has one, else icon if every item has one, else number)

align.description: List block on the left, or centred on screen (rows stay left-aligned)

focus.description: Dim earlier items while a new one appears; the full list brightens again for the hold

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

items.sub: Bank to bank, any time of day
No fee on regular person-to-person transfers
One ID across banks and apps

Comparison Columns.pickWhen: Comparing 2–3 options, products, plans or countries on the same attributes (a comparison table).

title.description: Heading above the table — What is compared: "UPI vs cards vs cash". — 1-8 words, max 1 line(s)

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

name.description: Column head — Option name. — 1-4 words, max 2 line(s)

icon.description: Lucide icon name for this item (fallback: none)

image_url.description: Picture above the column name (circle)

label.description: Row label (left column) — Attribute name: "Speed", "Fee", "Works offline". Phrase it so "yes" is good — ticks are green, crosses red. — 1-4 words, max 2 line(s)

a.description: Value for column 1 — Short value, or yes / no / – for a tick, cross or dash. — 1-5 words, max 2 line(s)

b.description: Value for column 2 — Short value, or yes / no / – for a tick, cross or dash. — 1-5 words, max 2 line(s)

c.description: Value for column 3 (only with 3 columns) — Short value, or yes / no / – for a tick, cross or dash. — 1-5 words, max 2 line(s)

best.description: Column that wins this row (1, 2 or 3) — its cell is highlighted

rows.description: Attributes compared (top to bottom). a / b / c are the cells for columns 1 / 2 / 3
rows.title: Row

highlight_column.description: Tint one whole column (e.g. the recommended option)

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

validation_notes.message: Row N: no value for column 3 — a dash is shown
validation_notes.rule: Fails per row when columns.length === 3 and that row's `c` is empty.

validation_notes.message: Row N: best = X but there are only Y columns
validation_notes.rule: Fails per row when `best` exceeds the number of columns given.

Bar Chart.pickWhen: Values compared across 3–10 categories: states, companies, years, products; rankings with numbers; a threshold to beat.

title.description: Heading above the chart — What is measured, with the unit if helpful: "Monthly UPI payments (₹ lakh crore)". — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)
examples: Top UPI apps by market share

prefix.description: Symbol before each value label — Currency or symbol before every value: ₹, $. — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

unit.description: Unit after each value label — Unit after every value: %, km, t. — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

reference_label.description: Label on the reference line (vertical charts) — Name of the reference line: "National average", "Target". — 1-4 words, max 1 line(s)

source.description: Source line under the chart — Where the data comes from: "Source: NPCI, March 2025". — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)

reference_value.description: Dashed line across the chart at this value (average, target, threshold)

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

label.description: Category label (under the bar, or left of it) — Category name: "PhonePe", "2024", "Kerala". — 1-3 words, max 2 line(s)

value.description: Bar value (raw number, same unit for all bars)

highlight.description: 1 = draw this bar in the accent colour (others turn grey)

bars.description: One bar per category, in the order given (unless sorted)
bars.title: Bar

orientation.description: Columns (vertical) or rows (horizontal, better for long labels)

sort.description: Keep the given order, or sort by value

highlight.description: Which bar gets the accent colour (bars[].highlight = 1 also works)

format.description: How numbers are displayed: plain = raw digits, indian_compact = ₹1.2 Cr / 45 L style grouping, international_compact = 1.2M / 45K style grouping.

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

Line Chart.pickWhen: A trend over time: growth, a crash, a peak, a recovery, or 2–4 things changing over the same years.

title.description: Heading above the chart — What is measured: "Petrol price in Delhi (₹/litre)". — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)

prefix.description: Symbol before every value — ₹, $. — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

unit.description: Unit after every value — %, /litre, pts. — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

reference_label.description: Label on the reference line — "Pre-covid level", "Target". — 1-4 words, max 1 line(s)

source.description: Source line under the chart — "Source: RBI, 2025". — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)

axis_labels.description: Year / month labels and value labels on the axes — 1-3 words, max 1 line(s)

reference_value.description: Dashed line across the chart at this value

image_url.description: Background image, shown when the background option is set to 'image'

transform.description: none · indexed (every series = 100 at the first point, to compare growth) · cumulative (running total)

area.description: Shade under the line (auto = on for a single series)

show_points.description: Dots on each point (auto = on up to 12 points)

end_labels.description: Value at the end of each line

format.description: How numbers are displayed: plain = raw digits, indian_compact = ₹1.2 Cr / 45 L style grouping, international_compact = 1.2M / 45K style grouping.

background.description: theme gradient, image_url, or transparent over footage

x_labels.description: Labels along the bottom, left to right.

series.description: Lines. values must have one number per x label (null for a gap).

values.description: Raw numbers, same length as x_labels.

at.description: x label or 0-based index of the point.

validation_notes.rule: Fails when x_labels has fewer than 4 entries.

validation_notes.message: At least one series is required
Series N has M values for L labels — extra values are dropped, missing ones are gaps
validation_notes.rule: Fails per series when values.length !== x_labels.length.

validation_notes.message: Series N has no name for the legend
validation_notes.rule: Fails per series when there is more than one series and that series has no non-empty name.

center_label.description: Text under the number in the donut centre — Words under the centre number: "of all payments". — 1-5 words, max 2 line(s)

prefix.description: Symbol before raw values — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

unit.description: Unit after raw values — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

source.description: Source line under the chart — "Source: NPCI, March 2025". — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)

label.description: Legend label — Part name: "PhonePe", "Defence". — 1-4 words, max 2 line(s)

highlight.description: 1 = pop this slice out and show it in the centre

slices.description: Parts of the whole, clockwise from 12 o'clock (unless sorted)

chart.description: Ring with a centre number, or a full pie

show.description: Share of the total, the raw value, or both

center.description: Donut centre: auto = highlighted (or largest) slice %, total = sum of values

sort.description: Keep the given order or largest first

highlight.description: Slice that pops out (slices[].highlight = 1 also works)

prefix.description: Symbol before every value — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

unit.description: Unit after every value — 1-1 words, max 1 line(s)

source.description: Source line under the list — "Source: Forbes, 2025". — 1-10 words, max 1 line(s)
